items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 8 at 2:05AM PDT until October 13 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, surf of 3 to 5 feet with
sets to 7 feet and dangerous rip currents expected. For the
Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding around high tides
expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 2 PM PDT Tuesday.
For the Beach Hazards Statement, through Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of beach parking lots, boardwalks, and
roads with only isolated road closures expected. Minor coastal
erosion is also expected. Additionally, elevated surf will
lead to strong rip currents and dangerous swimming conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides are expected to peak between
6.5 and 7.0 feet during the mornings and evenings.
items.instruction:
High astronomical tides possibly in combination with above normal
surf will likely produce minor flooding of low-lying areas along
the beach such as beach parking lots. Coastal officials should
take the necessary precautionary measures to safeguard their
beaches.

items.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 8 at 12:19AM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures in the upper 80s to mid 90s near higher
coastal terrain.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.
